name: Márianosztra (Hungary)
description: White field with a dark blue triangle in the lower hoist and a dark blue triangle in the upper fly corner, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Márianosztra (a blue shield with a yellow fleur-de-lis and a hand) below the name MÁRIANOSZTRA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
